extracted.name: Posh BLT
extracted.description: Love a BLT? Try our new take on the classic sandwich, with the staple ingredients of bacon, lettuce and tomato, plus some added extras for oomph
instruction_lines: Heat the grill to high. Put the bacon on a foil-lined baking sheet and drizzle with the maple syrup. Grill for 7-10 mins until crisp. Mix the mayo with the sundried tomato paste, then spread over two of the sourdough slices. Top with the bacon, sundried tomatoes and Little Gem. Season with black pepper, top with the remaining bread and halve.
